tools.name: book
tools.description: your book again (positions, cash, P&L) and the limits code enforces right now. Args: {}.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: the live bid, ask, spread, 24 h change and data age of a pair. Args: {symbol}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: features
tools.description: the indicators the screens use for a pair: returns over 1 h-30 d, EMAs and trends on 1 h/4 h/1 d, RSI, ATR, Bollinger position, 20×4 h range, volatility, volume ratio. Args: {symbol}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: depth
tools.description: the order book of a pair: the top levels each side and what a buy of $1,000 / $5,000 would pay above the mid. Args: {symbol}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: news
tools.description: what our feeds saw about a pair (or the market, symbol null) in the last N hours, most severe first, with article summaries. Args: {symbol|null, hours 1-72}.

anyOf.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: dossier
tools.description: our feeds' dossier on up to 5 pairs: the top items of the last 72 h, market-wide items, scheduled releases, moves nothing explains and items nobody confirmed. Args: {symbols}.

items.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: item
tools.description: one news item in full by the id the news tool shows (its first 12 characters are enough): title, source, confirmations, article summary and key points. Args: {id}.

id.description: The item id, or its first 12 characters.

tools.name: past_decisions
tools.description: the bot's last decisions on a pair (yours on the paper account, the timed cycles' before you, and yours in the shadow book), with how they turned out. Args: {symbol}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: scheduled US macro releases (FOMC, CPI, jobs, PPI, PCE, GDP) in the next N days. Args: {days 1-14}.

tools.name: history
tools.description: a pair's daily history from our history store (years deep): return, range, volatility, worst drawdown, biggest days, weekly closes. Args: {symbol, days 7-1825}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.

tools.name: past_news
tools.description: earlier news about a pair from our archive (beyond the last 30 days too), most severe first, with the price move 1 h, 1 d and 5 d after each. Args: {symbol, days 7-730}.

symbol.description: A pair exactly as listed, e.g. SOL/USD.
Pair exactly as listed, e.g. BTC/USD.

action.description: Pairs you don't hold: buy or no_trade. Pairs you hold (YOUR BOOK): hold, reduce or close. no_trade is a normal, often correct answer.

conviction.description: 0-100: how strongly the evidence supports the action. It is NOT a probability.

p_target_first.description: BUY only: probability 0-1 that take_profit is hit before stop_loss. A random walk gives stop_distance / (stop_distance + target_distance); deviate from that only as far as the evidence justifies. null otherwise.

stop_loss.description: BUY: stop price below the current price. HELD: a new stop price, or null to keep the current one.

take_profit.description: BUY: target price above the current price. HELD: a new target, or null to keep it.

horizon_hours.description: Expected holding period in hours (1-2160). When it elapses the position is reviewed, not sold.

size_pct_of_max.description: BUY only: a whole number from 10 to 100, the percent of the largest position the risk checks allow (100 = the largest, 50 = half of it). Size down when uncertain. null otherwise.

reduce_pct.description: REDUCE only: % of the position to sell (10-90); the rest stays open with its stop and target. null otherwise.

priced_in.description: How much of the thesis or catalyst the price already reflects.

thesis.description: 2-3 sentences: why this action, why now. Cite numbers from the brief or your tool results.

claim.description: One concrete statement, with numbers and dates where possible.

kind.description: fact = verifiable data (exchange numbers from CONTEXT, official announcements). sourced_claim = reported by a source in RESEARCH. estimate = your own quantitative estimate. speculation = plausible but unverified.

source_url.description: A URL that appears in the brief or a tool result and supports the claim, or null. Never invent URLs.

as_of.description: When the information was published or observed (ISO date/time), or null.

claim.description: One concrete statement, with numbers and dates where possible.

kind.description: fact = verifiable data (exchange numbers from CONTEXT, official announcements). sourced_claim = reported by a source in RESEARCH. estimate = your own quantitative estimate. speculation = plausible but unverified.

source_url.description: A URL that appears in the brief or a tool result and supports the claim, or null. Never invent URLs.

as_of.description: When the information was published or observed (ISO date/time), or null.

bear_evidence.description: 1-5 counterarguments and downside risks. Always include at least one.

risks.description: 1-4 key risk factors: event risk, liquidity, correlation with other holdings.

invalidation.description: The specific price level or event that proves the thesis wrong.

strategy.description: BUY only: the strategy the entry follows (discretionary when none fits). null otherwise.

decisions.description: 0-3 decisions, only about what woke you and what you hold. An empty list is a normal answer: watch instead of acting early.

kind.description: price_above / price_below: wake when the symbol trades above / below `level`. move_pct: wake when it moves `level` % either way from now. news: wake when an item about the symbol (null = market-wide) reaches severity `level` (0-100). time: wake at `at`.

symbol.description: The symbol exactly as listed. null only for news and time watches about the whole market.

level.description: The price, the % move or the minimum severity, as `kind` says. null for time watches.

at.description: time watches only: when to wake, as an ISO date-time with its offset. null otherwise.

hours.description: How long the watch lasts, 1-168 hours.

priority.description: risk = something you hold is in danger; opportunity = a possible entry; review = anything else.

note.description: At most 300 characters: what to check when it fires. You will see it then.

watches.description: 0-5 conditions to wake you on. Prefer a watch to deciding early.

cancel_watches.description: Ids of your own watches (from YOUR WATCHES) that no longer matter.

subject.description: A symbol exactly as listed, MARKET or BOOK.

text.description: At most 500 characters you want to see in your next brief on this subject (kept 14 days).

notes.description: 0-3 notes for later: a level that matters, what you are waiting for, what you learned.

reply.description: 1-3 sentences in plain English: what you saw and what you did about it. To an owner's question: the answer.
